estimator.estimator: forward photon density maps with a spectral camera gather

colors.observer: CIE1964 10-degree matching functions from Chroma's bundled table
colors.negative_components: Retain until spectral integration, then gamut clip for display
colors.units: relative radiant packet energy; no per-spectrum or per-frame normalization

source_mix.weighting: beam1/p; fill L*A*pi/(1-p) radiant energy per packet

fill_light.scope: Ceiling packets undergo the same full scattering, refraction and absorption transport as beam packets

estimator.normalize_by: all emitted photons N, never detected photon count or histogram maximum
scope: all emitted photons deposit into maps
first diffuse wall reflection; no later diffuse wall interreflection
finite spatial and wavelength bins introduce density-estimation bias
camera visibility and dielectric refraction remain wavelength dependent
RGB display uses a finite spectral approximation and exposure, not absolute photometric calibration

pmt.cutaway_scope: Camera-only visibility cut; every forward photon sees the complete PMT. No luminous cut cap is added.

ultraviolet.optional_display: Explicitly labeled UV false color; not visible radiance

pmt.calibration_scope: Repository full-detector software-validation tables, not measured PMT calibration. Endpoint values above500nm are extended for the visible ceiling source.
pmt.source_scope: 126–130nm narrowband VUV beam; this is not a full scintillation event

geometry_bvh.layout: Chroma uint32[N,4]; xyz pack lower16/upper16; w packs child_count:4 and first_child_or_triangle:28
geometry_bvh.triangle_ids: original exported triangle indices, unchanged by Morton ordering

inspection_views.name: pmt-cutaway
inspection_views.description: Diagnostic clipping of unchanged physical photon maps; violet UV display is false color when enabled.

inspection_views.name: pmt-cutaway-uv
inspection_views.description: Diagnostic clipping of unchanged physical photon maps; violet UV display is false color when enabled.

timing_scope: Diagnostic queue times during image review; other correctness jobs may share this GPU. No sustained performance or browser FPS claim.
